title: Activity and growth
description: Messages, voice time, active members, joins and leaves per day — compared with the previous period. The bot only stores counts, never message content.
weekdaysLabel: Average activity by day of the week
unavailableTitle: Statistics can’t be loaded right now
unavailableText: The database isn’t available, or your bot isn’t on the latest version yet. Try again in a few minutes.
offText: Turn it on under Modules, and from then on the bot counts messages, voice minutes, joins and leaves every day. It never saves message content.
paused: Tracking is paused — older data is kept, but no new data is being collected.
noData: No data has been collected for this period yet — check back tomorrow.
weekdaysNote: Average daily activity (messages + half a point per voice minute)
busiest: The busiest day: {day} — {messages} messages, {voice} of voice
topNote: in the last {period} days · 1 voice minute = half a message
noneActive: Nobody has been active in this period yet.
since: Tracking has been running on this server since {date}. The bot keeps daily data for the configured time (Settings → Activity).
